verses.text: Ha t'a peka' tzijtum tas yak'lab'ejnak Dios slolon t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Tzijtum el yak'lab'ejnak heb' schekab' yalaneli.
Haxo t'a slajwub' tiempoal tik, a wal Yuninal ix schekkot yal t'ayonh. Ha yet'ok sb'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'ay. Yak'annak paxkanoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yol sk'ab'.

Ha Yuninal chi' sch'oxan wal el sniwanil yelk'och Dios. Te lajannhej spensar yet' Dios chi'. Yujnhej slolonel Yuninal chi', wach'nhej yek' masanil tasi, yujto a slolonel chi' te niwan spoder. Ayik ix lajwi yik'ankanel ko mul, ix b'at em k'ojan t'a swach' k'ab' Dios t'a satcha'anh.
Ha Yuninal Dios chi', ek'alxo ix aj t'a yichanh heb' ángel, yujto a yopisio ak'b'il yuj Smam, ek'alxo niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh yopisio heb' ángel chi'.

Malaj junok heb' ángel b'aj ix yal Dios icha ix aj yalan t'a Yuninal. Haton ix yalan icha tik: Ha ach tik Wuninal ach. Ha t'a jun k'u tik ix wak' cheklajok to Wuninal ach, xchi. Ayik ix yalanxi Dios icha tik, manh yujok junok heb' ángel ix yala', palta yuj Yuninal chi' ix yala': Ha in tik, Mamab'il ol in aj t'ay, haxo Uninab'il ol aj t'ayin, xchi Dios.
Ayik ix schekankot jun pitanh Yuninal Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ix yalan yuj: Emokab' kuman masanil heb' wángel t'ay, xchi.
Haxo yuj heb' ángel yalnak Dios icha tik: Swak'och heb' wángel icha ik'al, haxo heb' tzin ak'an serwil, swak'och heb' icha yok k'aq'uil, xchi.
Palta syal pax Dios chi' yuj Yuninal icha tik: Ach Dios, Rey achnhej t'a masanil k 'inal. Ha ach tik, tojolnhej tzutej ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh heb' iko'.

Tzach tzalaji, tato wach' tas sk'ulej heb' anima, haxo tato a chukal sk'ulej heb' jun, schichon a k'ool. Yuj chi', ha Dios, haton a Diosal, A' ix ach sik'aneli, ix yak'an jun niwan tzalajk'olal t'ayach. Ha jun chi', ek'al niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh icha ix ak'ji t'a heb' ajun het'ok, xchi t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.
Syalanpax icha tik: Ach Kajal, atax t'a yichb'anel a b'onakkanem yich yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a ach pax wal lak'an a b'onakkan satcha'anh.
Ol satel masanil juntzanh tik, a achxo jun, ayachnhejeq'ui. Ha juntzanh tik ol ixtaxok, icha sk'ab'ik'och junok k'apak.
Ol a k'exkanel icha wal sk'exanel junok sk'a pichul heb' anima, syumankanel heb'. Ha achxo jun, hanheja' aji, malaj b'ak'uinh ol ach satelok, xchikan t'a Slolonel Dios chi'.

Malaj junelok ix yal Dios t'a junok ángel icha ix yutej yalan t'a Yuninal, ayik ix yalan icha tik: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab', masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi t'a Yuninal chi'.
Ha heb' ángel chi', espíritu ton heb', yak'umalnhej serwil Dios yaj heb'. Chekb'ilkot heb' yik skolwaj heb' t'ayonh a onh ol ko cha ko kolnab'il t'a junelnhej.
